thread:
billing-bot: automated flag  pricing-experiment credit applied to 9 customer invoices for GlobalEdge (INV-2026-05-GE-*) total credit = $210,000. system marked as "promotion" but product calls it "price rollback". please advise revenue restatement vs prospective deferral.
Marta: saw negative AR lines for GlobalEdge in the close queue. this was a post-invoice pricing rollback from a pricing experiment last week. @Eli can you summarize product ask?
Eli: product ran short A/B experiment and decided to roll back new list prices for a subset of legacy customers. they issued a credit equal to the delta between new and old pricing for usage billed YTD. intent: make customers whole for April and May. credits issued as invoice-line adjustments across invoiced periods (some prior month invoices are affected).
Priya: if credits are retroactive to prior periods, we may need to restate revenue for those periods if amounts were material. need run-rate of impact by period and check materiality threshold for restatement. provide schedule.
Sam: uploaded calc and invoice mapping: gs://redwood-billing/experiments/ge-price-rollback/1932004567-globaledge-credit-map.xlsx. summary: Apr-2026 = $80k, May-2026 = $95k, Jun-2026 (prebilled) = $35k. total 210k.
LegalBot: legal note: product agreed to rollback under pilot T&Cs and sent amendment emails. counsel confirms customer acceptance for credits.
Marta: immediate question for month-end: do we book credits as contra-revenue in the current period or adjust prior period revenue? auditors will expect consistent treatment.
Priya: accounting guidance: retrospective adjustment required only if it's a correction of error. Pricing changes are changes in accounting estimate or contract modification? This is a change in transaction price due to voluntary rollback; typically reduce current and future revenue prospectively unless credit represents consideration payable to the customer relating to previous period performance. Since product applied credits for past invoices, we should assess whether amounts were recognized in prior financials and whether they are material. If not material, we can record as current period adjustment (contra-revenue). If material, restate. Need balance sheet and P&L impact by period.
Eli: can you run the materiality check quickly? CFO threshold is 1% of revenue for the quarter (~$1.2M).
Sam: run completed: total 210k < threshold. individual period impacts: Apr 80k, May 95k, Jun 35k each < 1% of respective month revenue.
Priya: given amounts below threshold, propose to record as current period contra-revenue and not restate. However, we must document rationale and include auditor memo. JE suggested: ```DR Revenue Contra - Pricing Rollback 210,000
CR Accounts Receivable / Cash 210,000``` and break out schedule by impacted period in disclosure memo.
Marta: product ops asked whether these credits should be classified as marketing expense (promotion) to preserve revenue. we prefer contra-revenue. product wants to keep customer-facing message saying "we rolled back prices and credited you" not an expense line item.
Priya: GAAP: customer refunds/credits that reduce transaction price are contra-revenue. We'll not reclass to marketing.
Eli: for bookkeeping, some affected invoices are closed in prior-month AR and refunds will be processed as cash refunds to customers or applied as future credits depending on customer preference. will that change the JE?
Priya: no. whether we refund cash or apply a future credit, the accounting impact is the same: reduce revenue and increase refund liability or reduce AR. For month-end do: if refund processed now: DR Revenue Contra 210k CR Cash/Bank 210k. If refund held as credit on account: DR Revenue Contra 210k CR Refund Liability 210k. Sam, annotate which invoices are cash refunds vs account credits.
Sam: annotated file updated with refund type column. link: gs://redwood-billing/experiments/ge-price-rollback/1932004567-globaledge-credit-map_adjusted.xlsx
Marta: auditors will want the materiality calc and memo. Priya, can you draft the memo and attach to close pack? include product sign-off and LegalBot note.
Priya: will draft memo and upload to GCS at gs://redwood-finance/memos/1932004567-globaledge-pricing-rollback-memo.pdf and include JE ref JE-2026-05-501. ETA 90 minutes.
Eli: product will also add a flag in pricing experiments UI to mark credits as "retroactive" vs "prospective" so finance can automate next time. created ticket PROD-1337.
Marta: anything else for month-end? tax implications? VAT/GST on credits?
Priya: tax team: if credits are issued, we may need to issue credit notes for VAT purposes. @tax-team FYI ensure credit notes issued in local VAT jurisdictions. We'll include a tax checklist item in close pack.
Marta: great. keep messages brief. Priya post when memo and JE posted and I will sign off for close.
Priya: JE posted and memo uploaded at 1932004722. closing thread. billing-bot: month-end checklist updated item "GlobalEdge pricing rollback processed" completed by Priya at 1932004722.
